We are an independent, compassionate and ethical-practice focused veterinary referral centre for dogs and cats located in Marlow, Buckinghamshire, UK.

We offer a range of twelve specialist-led clinical services including Cardiology, Dentistry, Internal Medicine, Neurology + Neurosurgery, Oncology, Ophthalmology, Orthopaedics, Soft Tissue Surgery, Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation. Our Emergency and Critical Care departments operate 24-7-365. 

Team Ralph are the heart and soul of our hospital. They are what makes our ‘Centre of Excellence and Compassion’ just that – excellent and compassionate, and so much more besides. We have over 180 team members, including 17 Board-Certified Diplomates and over 60 nurses. 

The Ralph is very much a passion- and vision-driven hospital founded on a strong organisational culture and authentic core values. To find out more about our core values, check out our website www.theralph.vet
